name: Do I need to hire a separate painting contractor for my addition, or does Frasheski Construction handle it?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to hire a separate painting contractor for my addition, or does Frasheski Construction handle it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction offers comprehensive services for home additions, which typically include painting and finishing as part of the overall project. This streamlines the process and ensures coordination between all trades. While you have the option to hire a separate painting contractor, consolidating these services with your general contractor can often lead to better project management, fewer delays, and a more cohesive outcome. We ensure our team or trusted subcontractors deliver high-quality finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction typically includes painting and finishing as part of our comprehensive addition services, but you can hire a separate contractor if preferred.
